purpose: Proposed fresh setup baseline; no measurements or acceptance authorized.

protocol.cpu_exclusion_policy: Only a fresh CPU timeout at the frozen limit is an exclusion candidate. It never measures runtime or proves GPU usability; human review required.

measurements.description: Fresh process; compile outside measurement; block_until_ready on every output before timer start and after each call; perf_counter seconds; retain each repetition.
Same setup as runtime. Synchronize each named component, retain independent component samples and declare cumulative versus exclusive accounting; never substitute summed components for a full call.

Fresh process per repetition, fixed jit transform only. Cold: empty isolated persistent cache. Warm: separately seeded persistent cache at identical signature/revisions, record cache hit evidence. Retain tracing/lowering/compilation boundaries; no runtime substitution.

Fresh process per repetition, fixed jit transform only. Cold: empty isolated persistent cache. Warm: separately seeded persistent cache at identical signature/revisions, record cache hit evidence. Retain tracing/lowering/compilation boundaries; no runtime substitution.

Fresh isolated process per repetition; collect OS peak resident set size across the declared full workload, normalize platform ru_maxrss units to MiB. Includes setup/compile; record starting RSS separately. Not device memory.

Reset verified allocator high-water counter after warmup, synchronize full measured workload and retain peak allocated bytes. Require backend support; preallocation reservation, static memory analysis or one snapshot is not peak allocation.
